segments.summary: Reviewed the full owner prologue, native/A2A mappings, deterministic lifecycle rules, Overseer diagnostics, continuity addenda, and account-attribution negative space; the explicit unresolved bridged-account policy is the principal gap.
Reviewed the continuity tail, owner/consumer map, and PSMERA-002 through PSMERA-006; their external-only, backend, GUI, and DRY owner boundaries are explicit and internally coherent.
Reviewed PSMERA-007 through PSMERA-011: the event vocabulary is bounded, but ErrorEvent terminal behavior and the equivalence rule for legacy versus modern tool calls remain underspecified.
Reviewed PSMERA-012 through PSMERA-016: A2A failure/cancellation states are absent, and identity scope for deduplication plus stale, duplicate, and concurrent resume behavior is not deterministic.
Reviewed PSMERA-017 through PSMERA-021: auth and artifact partial failures lack cleanup/recovery transitions, while terminal conflicts and missing reviewer outcomes have no deterministic arbitration.
Reviewed PSMERA-022 through PSMERA-024: wake selection and resume attempt boundaries remain ambiguous, and provider correlation fields lack rotation, invalidation, and account-binding rules.
Reviewed PSMERA-025, the retired lineage bridge, migration coverage, and the FABLE addendum; final continuity schema changes remain deferred and approval target normalization is still unspecified.
